prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one production-ready transparent 2D game sprite for a cozy illustrated Korean fantasy side-scrolling RPG, "우리의 드리미 나이츠".
Primary request: an inviting magical region-travel portal, a complete freestanding oval arch that players recognize as a doorway.
Style: charming hand-painted watercolor/gouache anime storybook game prop, confident delicate dark-brown outlines, softly shaded ivory stone, warm antique gold inlays, seafoam teal crystals, small luminous stars and a small crescent moon at the keystone. Match warm pastel coastal village illustrations. Refined and tangible, not geometric UI, not photorealistic.
Composition: ONE arch, straight-on front view with a tiny amount of depth on the bottom stone doorstep, narrow upright oval opening. Entire arch, moon ornament and all base feet contained with generous transparent padding. Arch occupies about 74 percent of width and 84 percent of height. Two curved ivory side columns, tasteful gold vines and tiny seafoam gems. Bottom has a small low oval pale stone threshold that sits naturally on the ground. Inside the arch is EMPTY TRANSPARENCY so live animated light can be rendered there by the game. Outside also actual transparent alpha. Do not paint a portal scene or opaque interior.
Mood: enchanted, gentle, luminous, welcoming. Subtle warm highlights on the frame, crisp silhouette readable at 140 by 190 game pixels.
Text: none. No letters, arrows, captions, characters, background scenery, checkerboard, heavy glow cloud, rectangle, floating detached items, border or watermark. Produce exactly one isolated complete portal frame.
integration: One shared illustrated portal frame; destination-specific animated light, proximity response, locked seal, reduced-motion support. No changes to travel activation or story gates.
